files.Dockerfile:
FROM golang:1.22 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o /server ./cmd/server
FROM debian:bookworm-slim
COPY --from=build /server /server
ENTRYPOINT ["/server"]
